title: Cutthroat Island
description: A map written in Latin leads a slain pirate's daughter (Geena Davis) and her partner (Matthew Modine) to gold and into battle with a murderous uncle (Frank Langella).

title: Sands of Oblivion
description: An archaeologist uncovers terrifying secrets as he digs up the long-buried tablets of The Ten Commandments.

title: Blood From the Mummy's Tomb
description: An archaeologist (Andrew Keir) and his team bring back an embalmed Egyptian princess who takes over his daughter (Valerie Leon).

title: The Lair of the White Worm
description: An English nobleman (Hugh Grant) links a skull and a dragon legend to a vampire temptress (Amanda Donohoe).

title: Amityville II: The Possession
description: A priest tries to exorcize a couple's the oldest son in their Long Island home.

title: Amityville 3-D
description: A reporter's (Tony Roberts) wife (Tess Harper) and a psychic (Robert Joy) try to warn him, but he insists on buying a haunted house.

title: The Amityville Moon
description: A detective hired to find two runaway girls uncovers a horrifying secret at a boarding home run by the church.

title: The Bay
description: The residents of a seaside Maryland community become the unfortunate hosts of mutant, waterborne parasites that take control of their minds and bodies.

title: Bug
description: At a rundown desert motel, a woman (Ashley Judd) begins a tentative relationship with a newcomer (Michael Shannon), which quickly degenerates into paranoia after the man insists that he has tiny insects under his skin.

title: Cabin Fever
description: College students (Jordan Ladd, James DeBello, Rider Strong) fall prey to a flesh-eating virus after they head to the woods for a vacation.

title: Cabin Fever 2: Spring Fever
description: As students prepare for their high school prom, they have no idea a flesh-eating virus is spreading via a popular brand of water.
